prompt:
Rewrite snippets/review-summary.liquid so that it renders a summary of approved product reviews. Inputs (all top-level variables, nothing under section.settings): - `reviews`: array, never null, may be empty. Each element is an object with keys `author` (string or null), `rating` (integer 1-5) and `status` (string). - `featured_author`: string or null. Rules: 1. A review is approved only if its `status` is exactly the string `approved`. Matching is case-sensitive with no trimming, so `Approved`, `APPROVED` and `approved ` (trailing space) are NOT approved. Non-approved reviews are ignored completely (not counted, not averaged, not listed). 2. If there are zero approved reviews, output exactly: `

No reviews yet

` 3. Otherwise output exactly (no whitespace between any tags): `

COUNT

Average: W.T

    ITEMS
` - COUNT is `1 review` when there is exactly one approved review, otherwise `N reviews` (N = number of approved reviews). - Average: let A = (sum of approved ratings × 10) integer-divided by N (truncate, never round). W = A integer-divided by 10, T = A modulo 10. Examples: ratings 5,4,4 give `4.3`; ratings 5,5,4 give `4.6` (not 4.7); a single rating 4 gives `4.0`. - ITEMS: one `
  • NAME (R/5)
    • ` per approved review, in input order, where R is the rating. - NAME is the author with leading/trailing whitespace removed, HTML-escaped. If the author is null or empty after trimming, NAME is `Anonymous`. - CLASS is `review-summary__item`, or `review-summary__item review-summary__item--featured` when `featured_author` is non-null, non-empty AND the raw (untrimmed) author is exactly equal to `featured_author` (case-sensitive). A null or empty `featured_author` features nobody, including reviews whose author is null or empty. Comparison uses the raw author, so author ` Mia ` is not featured for `featured_author` `Mia` (though it displays as `Mia`). Output nothing else: no leading or trailing whitespace or newlines. Output only the specified elements/attributes; escape dynamic text and attributes. Inter-element whitespace, comments and quote style may vary; leaf text is exact. Change only snippets/review-summary.liquid. Do not suppress checks or hardcode case values. All input keys are present.
